note: promova.com declares almost no design custom properties. The only names harvested from same-origin stylesheets were a progress-bar vendor set (--bprogress-*) and --safe-area-inset-bottom. Design colours, type and radii were read from getComputedStyle on painted elements. See components-computed.json.

--bprogress-color.source: stylesheet :root, bprogress spinner. Not a design token.

themeSwitch: Not present. No data-theme, .dark or color-scheme switch was found. Pages paint one light scheme. Section backgrounds change (lilac hero, pink FAQ) and are section styles, not themes.
